question.prompt: Find \(\sin(-90°)\), that is, the sine of \(-\pi/2\) radians.

solutions.explanation: Sine is an odd function, so \(\sin(-90°)=-\sin90°=-1\).
solutions.title: Use sine's oddness

solutions.explanation: A negative angle turns clockwise, so a \(90°\) clockwise turn from the positive \(x\)-axis reaches the unit-circle point \((0,-1)\). Sine is the \(y\)-coordinate of this point, so \(\sin(-90°)=-1\).
solutions.title: Locate the negative angle
